{{Top}}
The '''M4.5-StarDrive maneuvering engine''' was a type of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] sublight drive built by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. Six of these were used aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|''Home One''-type]] and [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|''Liberty''-type]] variants of the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]], in conjunction with four [[M8.0-StarDrive engine|M8.0-StarDrive main engines]].

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While the combination of four main and six small engines matches the thruster arrangement of the [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], it does not directly match that of [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], which has nine exhaust nozzles of varying sizes.
